verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Folk has a REST API reference (overview, authentication, versioning, rate limits) and a quick-start guide, but nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples such as a 'try it' console or playground. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. A static reference and a walkthrough guide are adjacent to this story, not the interactive, runnable capability it asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
